title: Transactional Key-Value Store
description_html:
Design an in-memory key-value store with get(key) and set(key, value), then extend it with transactions and make it thread-safe.

Operations

  • set(key, value) / get(key) — basic store.
  • begin() — open a transaction.
  • commit() — apply the current transaction's changes.
  • rollback() — discard the current transaction's changes.

begin and rollback must be O(1). Transactions may nest. Then extend the design to work efficiently in a multi-threaded environment.

Example

set a 1
get a      -> 1
begin
set a 2
get a      -> 2
rollback
get a      -> 1

See Notes for the approach (override-layer stack + concurrency) and related problems (Refer).
